- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant congratulated the user on starting a regular laundry routine and provided tips for closet organization.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended categorizing and grouping clothes into categories (e.g., tops, bottoms, dresses, outerwear).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised assigning a specific section of the closet to each category to maintain organization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested maximizing vertical space using stackable shelves, hanging rods with multiple levels, or storage units with adjustable shelves.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended installing double rods to effectively double hanging space.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised investing in storage containers for items like socks, underwear, accessories, or out-of-season clothing and labeling each container.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested implementing a "one in, one out" policy to maintain organization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned considering a custom closet organizer system for extensive renovations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended keeping frequently worn items accessible and maintaining the organized space weekly.
